name: 86 Chaos 16.0.41 My Schedule Legacy Shift Visibility Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.41 My Schedule Legacy Shift Visibility Fix
notes: Fixes My Schedule visibility for existing, restored, and imported shifts that use legacy employee identity fields while preserving the current schedule UI and Firebase configuration.
releaseNotes: My Schedule now loads the selected month before filtering to the signed-in employee so legacy shifts without scheduleUserId are not hidden.
Shift matching now recognizes scheduleUserId and other canonical assignment fields before falling back to legacy email/name matching.
The schedule tab loads roster identity data when My Schedule needs it to map existing shifts safely to the current employee.
releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.41 My Schedule Legacy Shift Visibility Fix
